Can recorded killmails tell me exactly who is online in a system right now?
{"answer":"No. Killmails are partial records of combat events. They do not provide login status or a reliable current location for a pilot."}
Where am I right now?
{"answer":"I do not have your current location. Select a system, constellation, or region if you want an analysis of locally recorded activity there."}
